rows.content: In this "time of favor"<sup>1</sup> of a fast day, it is appropriate – and has already been practiced here in recent years – to speak "words of rebuke,"<sup>2</sup> and to utilize the "time of favor" to accept good resolutions in Torah study and observance of the commandments, in order to bring them down into actual deed, for the deed is the main thing.
